item.name: Common Crate
item.howToGet: Buy from the toy crate conveyor when a Common crate spawns. Cash prices are shown live on the belt.
item.cardSummary: Lowest conveyor rarity. Early cash crates for starter ASMR toys while you build income and conveyor luck.

item.name: Uncommon Crate
item.howToGet: Buy from the toy crate conveyor when an Uncommon crate spawns. Upgrading the conveyor improves higher-rarity luck.
item.cardSummary: Early conveyor step up from Common. Spend Cash on the belt and reinvest into conveyor upgrades for better rolls.

item.name: Rare Crate
item.howToGet: Buy from the toy crate conveyor when a Rare crate spawns. Conveyor cash upgrades raise luck toward higher rarities.
item.cardSummary: Mid-early conveyor rarity. More valuable ASMR toys than Common and Uncommon once your belt luck improves.

item.name: Epic Crate
item.howToGet: Buy from the toy crate conveyor when an Epic crate spawns. Conveyor upgrades and luck boosts help this tier appear more often.
item.cardSummary: Mid-game conveyor rarity. Worth grabbing when cash is stable so your field upgrades past early toys.

item.name: Legendary Crate
item.howToGet: Buy from the toy crate conveyor when a Legendary crate spawns. Higher conveyor luck and Luck weather help reach this tier.
item.cardSummary: Strong mid-game conveyor crate. Prioritize opening during luck boosts when you can afford the live belt price.

item.name: Mythic Crate
item.howToGet: Buy from the toy crate conveyor when a Mythic crate spawns. Needs solid conveyor upgrades and optional luck multipliers.
item.cardSummary: Late conveyor rarity with stronger ASMR payouts. Treat Luck weather and paid luck boosts as help, not requirements.

item.name: Divine Crate
item.howToGet: Buy from the toy crate conveyor when a Divine crate spawns. High conveyor luck and event luck windows are the practical path.
item.cardSummary: High conveyor rarity just below special event and premium tiers. Save cash so you can buy it when it rolls on the belt.

item.name: Honey Crate
item.howToGet: Can appear on the conveyor at a low natural rate. During Honey weather, about 1 in 5 conveyor crates can become Honey Crates for the 5-minute event.
item.contentsNotes: Honey-themed ASMRs. Named examples include Keyboard, Spoon, and Honey Comb. Exact full list and item count are not dual-sourced.
item.cardSummary: Event-linked conveyor crate. Farm hardest during Honey weather when Honey Crates spike on the belt, and still watch for rare off-event spawns.

item.name: Exotic Crate
item.howToGet: Buy from the toy crate conveyor when an Exotic crate spawns. High conveyor luck and Luck weather improve access.
item.cardSummary: High-tier conveyor crate above Honey on the rarity ladder. Cash only; exact drop odds are unpublished.

item.name: Godly Crate
item.howToGet: Buy from the toy crate conveyor when a Godly crate spawns. Top standard belt rarity before special permanent unlocks.
item.cardSummary: Highest normal cash conveyor rarity before Rebirth, Exclusive, and Limited specials. Open during luck windows when you can.

item.name: Rebirth ASMR
item.howToGet: Not a conveyor crate. Complete a rebirth that meets the cash and required ASMR conditions to receive one permanent Rebirth ASMR. Guides list up to 10 rebirths.
item.contentsNotes: One permanent Rebirth ASMR per completed rebirth. Survives rebirth wipes with Limited and Exclusive items. Cannot be sold.
item.cardSummary: Special ladder tier unlocked by rebirths, not the conveyor. Each rebirth awards a permanent Rebirth ASMR that stays through later resets.

item.name: Exclusive Golden Keyboard
item.howToGet: Not a conveyor crate. Purchase the VIP gamepass (about 119 Robux) from the in-game VIP button to receive the Exclusive Golden Keyboard.
item.contentsNotes: Exclusive Golden Keyboard ASMR. VIP also grants about +50% luck and +50% cash. Survives rebirth wipes.
item.cardSummary: Premium Exclusive tier from the VIP gamepass, not the crate belt. Unlocks the Golden Keyboard plus permanent luck and cash boosts.

item.name: Limited Prismwave Keyboard Crate
item.howToGet: Not a conveyor crate. Buy the Limited Prismwave Keyboard Crate with Robux at the center of the map when stock is available.
item.contentsNotes: Limited Prismwave Keyboard ASMR. Restock timing is unconfirmed.
item.cardSummary: Highest ladder tier via a Robux Limited crate at map center. Guides currently report the crate sold out with restock unknown.
